Read your level in the Analytical Assurance Decision Tool you used in step 1. The Analytical Quality and
Assurance Lead confirms a Level 4 BCA level.

{{< include /guidance/_partials/diagram-assurance-level-matrix.qmd >}}

### The likelihood {#the-likelihood}

::: {.nhsuk-inset-text}
**Note:** a full check of the likelihood in the Analytical Assurance Decision Tool is not required. An impact dimension has already scored Level 4, so the
work is Business Critical. In the impact 4 row of the matrix, every likelihood from Level 1 to
Level 4 gives Level 4 BCA.
:::

Write Level 4 BCA into the Specification and go on to step 4.

The Analytical Risk Assessment and Quality Assurance Framework may escalate work to Business
Critical analysis. If it does, and the work was not designated Business Critical, score the six impact dimensions
again with your commissioner. The work is Business Critical only if a dimension then scores Level 4.
